patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LinkedIn Sales Navigator and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

LinkedIn Sales Navigator and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Workflow advantage: LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans shared coverage; 6sense leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LinkedIn Sales Navigator and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync.; 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote .
- Company-size focus: LinkedIn Sales Navigator (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs 6sense (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning — vs 6sense-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans); 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead.

Poor-fit cases: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid LinkedIn Sales Navigator if you actually need 6sense's motion (Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
